facts.fact: Lesotho's Financial Intelligence Unit says the NICR gives banks and money lenders viewing rights to its national identity database to verify identity documents at onboarding, though not all have access.

LSO.note: Nothing on a civil register to ID link.
Nothing on a number at birth.
Nothing on who operates or owns the platform.
No public register keyed on the ID number named.

facts.fact: Lesotho's Financial Intelligence Unit says the NICR is custodian of the national identity database, against which identity documents and their ID numbers are authenticated, and the Ministry of Home Affairs produces the documents.

Lesotho's Financial Intelligence Unit says banks and money lenders verify customers' national identity documents against the NICR database at onboarding, where they hold viewing rights, which not all do.

LSO.note: Nothing on consultation of people outside government.
Nothing on local civil registration offices.
